tasks.do: Explain the concept of Dependency Injection (DI) in the context of Spring beans.
Demonstrate how to inject a bean into another @Bean method using parameters.
Demonstrate how to inject a bean into another @Bean method using direct method calls.
Explain why calling a @Bean method in a @Configuration class does not create multiple instances of a singleton bean.
Identify the cause of a `BeanCurrentlyCreationException` (Circular Dependency).
Predict the bean creation order when dependencies are present.
Understand that @Configuration classes are proxied to handle inter-bean references.
